# Login

fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='ka_burt@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0])['access_token']
content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path='~/backups/music.txt', access_token=fs_token)['content']

lines = [ln.rstrip('\n') for ln in content.splitlines()]

section = None
songs = []
albums = []
playlists = defaultdict(list)
current_playlist = None

for ln in lines:
    if not ln.strip():
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Song Library'):
        section = 'songs'
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Album Library'):
        section = 'albums'
        continue
    if ln.startswith('# Playlists'):
        section = 'playlists'
        current_playlist = None
        continue

    if section == 'songs':
        # "- Title by Artist" or "- Title by A, B"
        if ln.startswith('- '):
            item = ln[2:]
            if ' by ' in item:
                title, artist_part = item.split(' by ', 1)
                songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists_str': artist_part.strip()})
        continue

    if section == 'albums':
        if ln.startswith('- '):
            item = ln[2:]
            if ' by ' in item:
                title, artist_part = item.split(' by ', 1)
                albums.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists_str': artist_part.strip()})
        continue

    if section == 'playlists':
        # Playlist title line: "## Name"
        if ln.startswith('## '):
            current_playlist = ln[3:].strip()
            continue
        if ln.startswith('- ') and current_playlist:
            item = ln[2:]
            if ' by ' in item:
                title, artist_part = item.split(' by ', 1)
                playlists[current_playlist].append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists_str': artist_part.strip()})
        continue

print('songs_count', len(songs))
print('albums_count', len(albums))
print('playlists_count', len(playlists))
print('playlist_names', list(playlists.keys()))
